title: Case 028: Loose Water Pipe in the Back Garden
initial_request: Hi. The pipe become loose at the back garden as shown in the photo below.
overview: The tenant reported that a water pipe in the back garden had become loose and referenced a photo. Northbridge Lettings asked the landlord how to proceed and later followed up for an update. The landlord said they would arrange the repair and subsequently confirmed it was completed. The request was marked complete without payment.
outcome: The landlord confirmed that the outdoor pipe had been repaired; the task was completed without payment.
